summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of Workflow Studio. Backend: 10/10 pytest tests pass covering /api/, /api/health, and full projects CRUD (create-auto-id, create-with-supplied-id, list, get, update-preserves-createdAt, delete, 404 branches). Frontend: dashboard renders, project creation opens editor with palette + canvas + sidebar, guided builder plus-buttons + node picker (Start->Decision, plus-left picker-process labeled 'Yes', plus-right picker-end labeled 'No') work, undo/redo works (6->3->6 nodes), auto-layout both vertical and horizontal work, validation panel shows Yes/No branch warnings when missing and clears when branches exist, delete-node-btn removes node, keyboard Delete key removes node, rich detail editor open/type/bold/save works, play mode start/next/branch/restart/stop works, settings dialog with tabs (General/Workspace/Appearance/Editor/About) works, theme dark/light toggles html.dark class, workspace switch to remote + test-remote-connection returns ok, export-btn triggers .wflow file download (TEST_Export_Project.wflow), import-btn opens file input, auto-save persists project across reload (TEST_Persist_Project visible with node count after reload).
action_items: MINOR (code quality): RightSidebar inputs use data-testid='node-title-input' and 'node-short-desc-input' which collide with the WorkflowNode selector pattern [data-testid^='node-'] used to enumerate canvas nodes. Consider renaming to e.g. sidebar-title-input / sidebar-short-desc-input to avoid brittle tests.

MINOR (console): React warning 'Updating a style property during rerender ... Removing borderColor border' appears when starting play mode (TopBar Play button toggles inline borderColor while also having border shorthand from ws-btn-play). Consolidate border shorthand vs longhand in the play button style to silence.
INFO: The React Flow attribution warning is expected (free tier).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py properly excludes MongoDB _id from all responses via projection {'_id':0}. Good.
server.py: PUT preserves createdAt from existing doc and bumps updatedAt. Correct.
server.py forces storageType='remote' on create/update regardless of payload — intentional since this is the remote provider, OK.
@app.on_event('shutdown') is deprecated in newer FastAPI; prefer lifespan handler. Not blocking.
Frontend: theme is applied via html.dark class + localStorage — persists correctly.
Auto-save via IndexedDB (Dexie) works and persists across full page reload in personal workspace.
test_credentials: N/A - no auth in this app
seed_data_creation: Test projects (TEST_project_auto, TEST_supplied, TEST_UI_Project, TEST_Persist_Project, TEST_Export_Project) created during tests. Backend TEST_ projects cleaned up via pytest session fixture. Frontend IndexedDB projects remain in preview browser storage but each Playwright session uses a fresh context.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 15 review-request items verified working. Backend has full pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (JUnit XML at /app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml). Frontend selectors are stable EXCEPT that [data-testid^='node-'] also matches sidebar input testids (node-title-input, node-short-desc-input) — filter these out in queries or expect the count to include them. Theme dark mode is applied via document.documentElement.classList (html.dark), NOT data-theme attribute or body class. To reach theme buttons in Settings, click data-testid='settings-tab-appearance' first. Validation-list DOM element only renders when there are warnings.
